newsitem.title: USA: BPI Packaging supply deal to up sales.
newsitem.headline: BPI Packaging supply deal to up sales.

text.p: BPI Packaging Technologies Inc said on Thursday it reached a 10-year agreement with an unidentified major building products firm which would increase sales $6 million annually by October.
BPI, which would supply its new proprietary film to the company, said in a statement it expected sales to increase to $50 milion in the next five years.
The film would be used around fiber glass insulation, it said.

"This development puts BPI in a favorable strategic position in the fiber glass insulation market should the industry decide that improved protective packaging for fiber glass insulation is necessary for health and safety reasons," Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Dennis Caulfield said in a statement.
